in_hebrew.name: יהושע
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יהושע הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'ה' הוא המושיע' או 'ישוע הוא ה''. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'יהו' שפירושו 'ה'', ו'שע' שפירושו 'מושיע'. השם יהושע הוא שם חשוב בתנ''ך, והוא נזכר לראשונה בספר יהושע, פרק א', פסוק א'. יהושע היה מנהיג ישראל אחרי משה, והוא הוביל את עם ישראל לכיבוש הארץ המובטחת. השם יהושע הוא גם שם של ישוע המשיח, שפירושו 'ישוע הוא ה''.

in_greek.name: Ἰησοῦς
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἰησοῦς (Iēsous) εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν, ὃς ἦλθεν εἰς σωτηρία ἡμῶν. Τὸ ὄνομα Ἰησοῦς παρὰ τῶν Εβραίων ἐστὶ σύνθετον, ἐκ τῶν λέξεων 'Ἰεχωβά' καὶ 'σωτήρ'. Ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὰ Εὐαγγέλια εἰς τὸ κεντρικὸν πρόσωπον ἀπεδείχθη, ὡς ὁ Σωτήρ ἡμῶν ἀπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν.

in_latin.name: Iesus
in_latin.meaning: Iesus est salvator et Deus noster
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Iesus est compositum ex duobus verbis: 'Iehovah' et 'salvator'. Iesus est nomen Hebraeum, quod in lingua Latina interpretatur 'salvator' vel 'Deus salvator'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Iesus fuit datum Salvatori nostro, qui venit ad salvandos homines a peccatis suis. Nomen Iesus est etiam nomen proprii Sancti Iesu Christi.

in_english.name: Yehosha
in_english.meaning: God is salvation, or the Lord saves
in_english.long_meaning: Yehosha is a Hebrew name that means 'God is salvation' or 'the Lord saves'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'Yah' (יהו), meaning 'God', and 'yasha' (ישע), meaning 'to save'. In the Bible, Yehosha is the name of Joshua, the leader who succeeded Moses and led the Israelites to conquer the Promised Land. The name Yehosha is also associated with Jesus Christ, who is considered the ultimate savior in Christianity. The name Yehosha symbolizes spiritual salvation, divine protection, and guidance. It is a powerful and meaningful name in Christian tradition, reflecting the values of faith, hope, and redemption.

biblical_reference.note: The name Yehosha is mentioned in the book of Joshua, chapter 1, verse 1, as the leader who succeeded Moses.

seo.title: Yehosha - God is Salvation (Hebrew, Christianity)
seo.meta_description: Discover the meaning, origin, and religious significance of the name Yehosha. Learn about its usage and appeal in Christianity.
seo.description_paragraph: The name Yehosha is of Hebrew origin and is rooted in the monotheistic religion of Christianity. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'Yahweh' (God) and 'shua' (salvation), which together mean 'God is Salvation'. The name is significant in Christianity as it symbolizes the belief in God's saving power and intervention in the lives of believers.
